title: Binary adjoined-root linear map
statement: For a natural number $\ell$ and a binary vector $m$ of length $\ell$, the binary cube of length $\ell$ maps linearly over the field with two elements to the root-adjoined algebra of the polynomial $X^\ell+\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}m_iX^i$, by the binary adjoin-root encoding.
caveat: The encoding function is not defined in the supplied snippet, so the map's explicit coordinate formula cannot be verified.
